observations: Photo 0: Black PS4 'Fat' style console (thick, non-slim/non-pro body) lying flat on a fabric surface, with two DualShock 4 controllers (one blue/silver, one red) resting on top and a USB charging cable.
Photo 1: Same black console standing upright against a couch, PlayStation logo visible on the front edge, same two controllers in front, USB cable coiled below.
Top casing shows visible scuff marks, light scratches and a thin line crease across the lid in both photos.
No power cable or HDMI cable visible in either photo, only a short USB (controller charging) cable.
No screen, menu, or storage information shown; no serial number, model plate, or box visible.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'YUNG HITCH' overlay both images, consistent with a resale listing.

identity.kind: PS4 'Fat' game console with two wireless controllers
read_from: photo 1 (PlayStation logo visible on front of console)

claims.claim: London used (implies imported, lightly used UK unit)
claims.evidence: No shipping label, import sticker, or region marking visible in either photo.
Photo 1 shows visible scuffs, scratches, and a crease line on the top casing, suggesting handling wear rather than pristine condition.
No screen-on photo, menu screenshot, or storage/game list shown in either photo.

risks.risk: No power or HDMI cable shown, which are essential for operation and typically bundled with a working unit
risks.proof: A photo showing the full cable set (power brick, HDMI, USB) laid out with the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controllers only, without power/video cables

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have disk-read/HDD faults common in older PS4 Fat units
risks.proof: A short video of the console powering on to the home screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case: non-functional)

risks.risk: Storage capacity (500GB/1TB) unknown, which affects value
risks.proof: A photo of the system storage settings screen or the rear/bottom capacity label
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common capacity (500GB)

risks.risk: Claimed pre-loaded games cannot be confirmed, and digital licenses may not transfer to a new account
risks.proof: A screenshot of the library/game list on the console screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as no bundled games (hardware only)

risks.risk: Controller battery health and analog stick drift cannot be assessed from static photos
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connected and stick movement in a game or settings test
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers of unverified condition (assume average wear)

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the home screen
Photo of the full cable set (power cord, HDMI cable, USB cable)
Photo/screenshot of storage capacity and system settings
Close-up photos of the top and underside casing to assess scratch/dent severity
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 'Fat' console with two controllers, but functionality, storage, included cables, and claimed game library are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (untested, base storage, no extra cables, cosmetic wear as shown) pending the listed proofs.
